title: SPA auth swap: @supabase/supabase-js sign-in/session, /sign-in page, password reset, bearer wiring, dev proxy
objective: Replace oidc-client-ts with the Supabase JS client in the SPA: browser Supabase client from VITE_SUPABASE_URL/VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, an SPA-rendered /sign-in route (email/password) plus password reset, Supabase access token attached as bearer on /api/v1 calls with client-managed refresh, and local dev proxy wiring to the function runner (M-25, P-01, spec 10).
scope: Single browser Supabase client module (auth only — the SPA data path stays exclusively /api/v1)
/sign-in route: email/password via signInWithPassword; generic failure message (no account enumeration); post-sign-in landing on /app; last-active-tenant landing preserved via /me
Password reset: resetPasswordForEmail flow + the reset-completion route per GoTrue redirect config (T-002 site/redirect URLs); uniform confirmation messaging
API client layer: attach current session access token as Authorization bearer; refresh handled by supabase-js; 401 handling triggers re-auth flow
Remove oidc-client-ts and all Keycloak-era auth code/config from the SPA
Vite dev proxy: /api/v1 (and /api/cron for manual testing) to the local function runner (vercel dev or documented equivalent); npm run dev orchestrates both
Env plumbing: VITE_SUPABASE_URL + VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY consumed at build time; no server-only secret in the bundle
out_of_scope: Any visual redesign (P-01 allows only the sign-in-surface change)
implementation_details: Redux integration: session slice sources identity from the Supabase session + /me; auth state changes (onAuthStateChange) update the store; sign-out clears tenant-scoped state (existing tenant-switch semantics preserved).
The one accepted login-surface change: SPA-rendered sign-in replaces Keycloak-hosted themed pages — keep styling within the existing design system (project memory: build on the design-system layer).
Generic error rendering for all sign-in failures (P-01/spec 16 enumeration prevention).
Guard: axios/fetch interceptor reads the session token per request (not cached at module init) to stay refresh-safe.
Verify existing Vitest component tests still pass; add component tests for the sign-in form states (loading/error/success).

unit: Sign-in form component: submit calls signInWithPassword; failure renders generic message; success navigates (Vitest component tests)
integration: Against local stack: seeded auth user signs in from the SPA dev build and /me succeeds with the bearer token; token refresh does not break subsequent calls
npm run dev serves SPA + functions with the proxy; /api/v1/health reachable from the SPA origin
e2e: Dedicated real-login Playwright spec (adapted fully in T-043; a smoke variant may be added here)

SPEC/ROUTE DISCREPANCY: spec 10 and AC-032 say post-sign-in landing is "/app", but the SPA has no /app prefix - the authenticated tree is mounted at "/" with DefaultLanding resolving the last active tenant and first permitted page. Sign-in navigates to "/" (or back to the originally requested protected route). Introducing an /app prefix would rewrite every route, test and e2e locator, well outside this task. Flagged rather than resolved unilaterally.
